title: Copperline Community League Rulebook
brief: The playing rules: match length of 2 halves of 40 minutes, rolling substitutions, matchday squad of at most 16, kit and ball requirements, points for a win (3), draw (1) and loss (0). State all of these numbers.

title: Discipline Code
brief: Cards and bans: five yellow cards in a season is a one-match ban, a red card is a ban of at least two matches, how yellows reset at the mid-season break (they do not), and how appeals go to the league office within 48 hours.

title: Registration and Eligibility Rules
brief: Who can play: minimum age 16, one club per season, the registration window closing on 2026-09-20, ID check on first appearance, and the player id format PL-123.

title: Fixtures and Postponement Policy
brief: How fixtures are set and when matches are postponed: weather calls made by 10:00 on match day, rearrangement within 14 days, forfeits after 15 minutes with fewer than 7 players.

title: Venue Guide
brief: The four venues: Harbour Park (3G artificial pitch, car park behind the east stand), Quarry Lane (natural grass, slow drainage), Old Mill Ground (natural grass, street parking only), Ridge Meadow (hybrid grass, large car park of about 120 spaces). Include changing rooms and accessibility notes.

title: Team Sheet: Ashquill Rovers
brief: Squad list for Ashquill Rovers (ASH) in the premier division, home ground Harbour Park, including Tomas Verrin (PL-114, forward) and Idris Calloway (PL-121, midfield), plus six more invented players with ids.

title: Team Sheet: Norrowby United
brief: Squad list for Norrowby United (NOR) in the premier division, home ground Quarry Lane shared with Quarrimoor Town, including Pavel Orsini (PL-137, forward), plus invented players with ids.

title: Team Sheet: Rivelmere Wanderers
brief: Squad list for Rivelmere Wanderers (RIV) in the championship division, home ground Old Mill Ground, including Lena Harrowgate (PL-203, forward), plus invented players with ids.

title: Team Sheet: Lowfennel Albion
brief: Squad list for Lowfennel Albion (LOW) in the championship division, home ground Ridge Meadow shared with Brackenwhist FC, including Nell Tarrant (PL-236, defender), plus invented players with ids.

title: Referee and Assessor Guide
brief: How referees are appointed, the one assessor per matchday, match reports due within 24 hours, how cards are recorded, and the 10:00 weather inspection.

title: Captains Handbook
brief: What captains must do: submit the team sheet 60 minutes before kick-off, handle opponents and officials, contact the league office Monday to Thursday 18:00 to 21:00, and manage squad registrations.

title: Season Calendar 2026 Autumn
brief: Key dates: season start 2026-09-05, mid-season break from 2026-11-14 to 2026-11-22, final league day 2026-12-12, cup final on 2026-12-19 at Harbour Park.

title: Code of Conduct
brief: Expected behaviour of players, coaches and spectators: respect for officials, zero tolerance for abuse, how sideline behaviour is reported, and sanctions up to a club points deduction.

title: Copperline Cup Rules
brief: The knockout cup: all eight clubs enter, single-leg ties, extra time of 2 halves of 10 minutes then penalties if level, final on 2026-12-19, and how yellow cards carry over from the league.
